The master asks slave 1 to "Write Multiple Coils": write 3 coils starting from 00001 (2 ON / 1 OFF)

── Data details ──
00001 = ON
00002 = OFF
00003 = ON

── Byte-by-byte ──
01     Slave address   device 1
0F     Function code   0x0F = Write Multiple Coils
00 00  Start address   protocol address 0, PLC address 00001
00 03  Write quantity  write 3 coils
01     Byte count      1 bytes of write data
05     Write data      each bit is the state to write to one coil (LSB first within each byte)
4F 54  CRC check       CRC16 check passed

── Notes ──
CRC check passed

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus RTU (10 bytes total)
Slave address: 1
Function: 0x0F (Write Multiple Coils)
Start address: 0 (PLC 00001)
Write quantity: 3
Byte count: 1
Data: 05
CRC16: 0x544F (wire order 4F 54, passed)
PDU: 0F 00 00 00 03 01 05
